title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains 1.5.57
body_markdown:
* Added: Code review with Suggested Changes panel.
* Added: MCP prompt files support.
* Added: New settings for creating instruction and prompt files.
* Added: Improved Ask mode layout for better usability.
* Added: Automatic history migration from Ask mode to Agent mode.
* Added: MCP sampling support for advanced interactions.
* Added: MCP elicitation support.
* Added: MCP resource support for extended functionality.
* Added: Tool grouping for better organization.
* Fixed: Session disposal issues causing unexpected behavior.
* Fixed: Inlay display updates when changing font size.
* Fixed: Updated tools status method for reliability.
* Fixed: Chat reference spacing for cleaner appearance.
* Fixed: Multiple edits to the same file failing in Agent mode.
